review_kind: Sole affected-only, original-source text SCI/ZHEN review of the five D662 task-text revisions addressing D658-F1 through D658-F3.

definitions.SCI: Physical correctness and preservation of usable quantities, units, model conditions and formulas within the affected task text.
definitions.ZHEN: Source-faithful Chinese/English wording and requested scope, without unsupported compulsory problem parts.
definitions.PASS: Only the stated affected text passes; not whole-lesson, display, native-finalization, publication or course approval.
definitions.PASS_REUSED: Prior D658 approval reused with exact file-hash and byte identity; no new substantive answer review.
definitions.HOLD: The separately held registration/display or historical-glyph scope remains held.

settled_findings.formula_disposition: D658's Q=q^2/(2C) model and approved 0.005 J answer remain applicable; neither is re-solved or rewritten here.
settled_findings.bilingual_disposition: Restored Chinese SI charge datum agrees with the source and the unchanged English datum already approved in D658.

settled_findings.revision: Both compulsory inductive-versus-capacitive classification requests are removed. Both tasks now request impedance magnitude only, matching the original requested quantity.
settled_findings.preserved: All numerical data and units, series topology and negligible resistance are unchanged. No replacement question or compulsory quantity was added.
settled_findings.formula_disposition: D658's |Z|=|X_L-X_C|, X_L=2*pi*f*L and X_C=1/(2*pi*f*C) remain applicable. The unchanged approved answers may retain the explanatory inductive interpretation; it is no longer a required task part.
settled_findings.bilingual_disposition: The revised Chinese and English requests and conditions are equivalent.

settled_findings.revision: Both extra questions asking whether the data determine current lead or lag are removed. Both tasks retain the phase-difference magnitude request.
settled_findings.preserved: Average-power interpretation, sinusoidal steady state, amplitude rather than RMS data, all values and units, and the phase-magnitude request are unchanged.
settled_findings.formula_disposition: D658's P=(U_m*I_m/2)*cos(phi) remains applicable. Its approved cos(phi)=0.8 and phase magnitude about 36.9 degrees are reused, not recalculated. The unchanged answers retain the caveat that lead/lag is undetermined; no phase sign is asserted by the revised tasks.
settled_findings.bilingual_disposition: The revised Chinese and English phase-magnitude requests and model conditions are equivalent.
